name: BE candidate read-only probe

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      approved_revision:
        description: Exact reviewed main commit approved for this one read-only request
        required: true
        type: string
      mode:
        description: Fixed bridge probe or independently pinned held strict-app probe
        required: true
        default: bridge
        type: choice
        options:
          - bridge
          - held-app
          - held-app-acceptance
          - held-app-final

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ inputs.mode != 'bridge' && 'be-candidate-probe-held-app' || 'be-candidate-probe-dpl_525LvEPCBud7nyAeFTcRx8iipTrk' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  probe:
    if: >-
      github.repository == 'khuonghuyhieu/esty-admin' &&
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.run_attempt == '1' &&
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.sha == inputs.approved_revision
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 3
    environment: be-production
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact approved probe without persisted credentials
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.approved_revision }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set pinned Node without installation or dependency cache
        uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.22.1
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Request only the existing candidate health endpoint once
        if: inputs.mode == 'bridge'
        env:
          BE_PROBE_ENVIRONMENT: be-production
          BE_PROBE_WORKFLOW_SHA: ${{ inputs.approved_revision }}
          BE_ACTIVATION_PACKET_JSON: ${{ vars.BE_ACTIVATION_PACKET_JSON }}
          BE_ACTIVATION_PACKET_SHA256: ${{ vars.BE_ACTIVATION_PACKET_SHA256 }}
          VERCEL_AUTOMATION_BYPASS_SECRET: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_AUTOMATION_BYPASS_SECRET }}
          BE_ACTIVATION_BRIDGE_INPUTS: ${{ secrets.BE_ACTIVATION_BRIDGE_INPUTS }}
        run: node apps/api/scripts/activation-candidate-probe.mjs
      - name: Verify current main before the held request
        if: inputs.mode != 'bridge'
        id: held-main
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          current="$(gh api repos/khuonghuyhieu/esty-admin/commits/main --jq .sha)"
          test "$current" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          printf 'revision=%s\n' "$current" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Request only the pinned held application acceptance surface
        if: inputs.mode != 'bridge'
        env:
          BE_PROBE_ENVIRONMENT: be-production
          BE_PROBE_WORKFLOW_SHA: ${{ inputs.approved_revision }}
          BE_PROBE_CURRENT_MAIN: ${{ steps.held-main.outputs.revision }}
          BE_D1_HELD_APP_BINDING: ${{ vars.BE_D1_HELD_APP_BINDING }}
          BE_D2_APP_ACCEPTANCE_GATE: ${{ vars.BE_D2_APP_ACCEPTANCE_GATE }}
          BE_ACTIVATION_PACKET_JSON: ${{ vars.BE_ACTIVATION_PACKET_JSON }}
          BE_ACTIVATION_PACKET_SHA256: ${{ vars.BE_ACTIVATION_PACKET_SHA256 }}
          BE_ACTIVATION_APP_INPUTS: ${{ secrets.BE_ACTIVATION_APP_INPUTS }}
          VERCEL_AUTOMATION_BYPASS_SECRET: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_AUTOMATION_BYPASS_SECRET }}
        run: node apps/api/scripts/activation-candidate-probe.mjs
      - name: Preserve the successful held receipt
        if: inputs.mode != 'bridge'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@b7c566a772e6b6bfb58ed0dc250532a479d7789f # v6
        with:
          name: held-app-probe-${{ github.run_id }}-1
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/held-app-probe.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
